_about: Read-only phone-over-cable table for the connect-ios skill. Code reads it (envrec.remote.ios); edit this file, not the Python. Nothing outside `aspects` can be asked.
columns: how the value becomes the fact: text | int | bool | gb | hash

errors.sentence: libimobiledevice is not installed (brew install libimobiledevice)
the phone did not answer in time; unlock it and watch for the Trust prompt
the owner did not trust this computer on the phone: stopped, nothing was read
the phone is waiting for you: unlock it and tap Trust, then run this again
the phone is locked: unlock it, then run this again
the phone is not attached: connect the cable
the phone did not complete the handshake: unlock it and tap Trust when it asks

plan_template: read the {aspect} of {device_hint} over the cable: `idevice_id -l` to see which devices are attached, then `ideviceinfo -u <that identifier> -k <KEY>` for {keys}. Read-only: it writes nothing to the phone. The phone may ask you to tap Trust; unlock it first. The identifier is never stored and the name is kept only as a salted hash.
default_device_hint: the attached device whose identifier hashes to the entry
hint: connect the cable, unlock the phone and tap Trust when it asks, then re-run
